card.text: Explore Aegaeon, a small moon of Saturn, through its measured shape.

introduction.text: Aegaeon is a tiny, elongated moon embedded in Saturn’s G-ring arc. Cassini images measured its outline; impacts on the moon can supply dust to the arc.

model.title: Approximate shape model
model.summary: Shape based on Cassini's measured dimensions. Gray grid: no imagery; the model does not resolve local terrain.
